title: Synthesis of 4H-pyrimido[2,1-b]benzimidazoles catalyzed by a Schiff base cobalt(II) complex supported on cobalt ferrite magnetite nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17503-17515
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02906F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahmad Reza Moosavi-Zare, Zahra Darvishi, Hamid Goudarziafshar, Abedien Zabardasti
Nano-[CoFe2O4@SiO2/propyl-1-(o-vanillinaldimine)][CoCl2] was designed and reported as a Schiff base cobalt(II) complex and recoverable catalyst for the synthesis of 4H-pyrimido[2,1-b]benzimidazoles under solvent-free condition.
